user.name: Josh Davis
user.bio:
I am a Sr Technical leader and US Air Force Veteran with over 20 years of experience in TechOps and Software Platform Engineering. I currently serve as a Manager within Enterprise Architecture & Strategy at DTE Energy, leading the Developer Platform (DevPlat) & Tools organization.

My work is defined by a 'Platform-as-a-Product' philosophy, where I focus on transforming enterprise IT into cloud-first, platform-as-code-driven digital enterprises. I specialize in:
- Building secure, scalable developer platforms and 'Golden Paths'
- Driving cloud governance, FinOps cost optimization, and architectural standards
- Modernizing engineering workflows using GitOps, ArgoCD, and automated platform delivery
- Enabling AI-powered engineering and developer productivity
- Leveraging DORA & SPACE metrics to drive measurable KPIs (Lead Time, Deployment Frequency, Change Fail Rate)

I am passionate about reducing operational toil through SRE principles and establishing enterprise-wide engineering best practices that make the right thing the easy thing.
